A cooling gel-style sheet mask designed to deliver concentrated hydration while helping skin feel smoother, softer and refreshed. Its jelly texture provides a close fit to the skin for a comfortable moisture-boosting treatment.

Key Benefits

  • Provides intensive hydration.
  • Helps soften and smooth the skin.
  • Leaves skin feeling refreshed and replenished.
  • Gel texture helps deliver a comfortable close fit.
  • Supports a plumper, more hydrated-looking complexion.
  • Suitable as an occasional moisture-boosting treatment.

How to Use

After cleansing and toning, remove the mask from the pouch and apply evenly to the face. Leave on for the recommended time stated on the packaging, then remove and gently pat in any remaining essence.

Suitable For

Normal, dry, combination and dehydrated skin, especially when skin feels tight, dull or lacking moisture.

Normal skin Dry skin Combination skin Dehydrated skin
